notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Keep the buyer, the expert and the evidence distinct.
intro: A proposed revenue-data workbench for Qualitate: classify research buyers, preserve account and contact provenance, and prepare a useful study-discovery handoff.
queueIntro: Investment and corporate strategy teams may buy research, while experts contribute to it. A shared email domain or employer mention is not enough to merge their roles.
workbenchIntro: Review role, account identity, source conflict and buyer question. These fictional examples contain no expert transcripts, confidential research or investment recommendations.
firstBuild: A buyer brief with a governed identity trail
firstBody: Map a research organization and its current question to the right seller while preserving contact roles, source freshness and the reason behind a proposed CRM update.

fields.label: Contact provenance and source date recorded
Specific market or research question recorded
Required CRM fields and definitions validated

rules.title: Keep the expert pathway separate
rules.next: Do not enroll an expert participant in a buyer-sales sequence merely because they appear in the same research ecosystem.

rules.title: Resolve the contact’s role
rules.next: Verify whether the person is a research buyer, contributor or another stakeholder before routing.

rules.title: Resolve the buying organization
rules.next: Confirm the firm, business unit and parent relationship before merging account records.

rules.title: Review conflicting evidence
rules.next: Preserve both sources and resolve the current professional role rather than overwriting one with a guess.

rules.title: Attach contact provenance
rules.next: A usable record needs an accountable source and date, not only a filled email field.

rules.title: Capture the research question
rules.next: Find which market, buyer behavior or strategic decision the team wants to understand.

rules.title: Assign the buyer handoff
rules.next: A qualified research question needs a receiving seller and a clear next conversation.

rules.title: Validate the CRM field contract
rules.next: Keep required values, allowed states and update ownership consistent with the agreed data model.

ready.title: Ready for a research-buyer handoff
ready.next: The seller can inspect the buyer role, organization, evidence and research question. This does not approve study content or expert participation.

experiments.name: Role-aware research enrichment
experiments.hypothesis: Separating buyers and contributors reduces incorrect routing.
experiments.primary: Correct buyer handoffs per reviewed record
experiments.guardrail: Expert contacts placed in buyer sequences
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: Question-led account briefing
experiments.hypothesis: A specific research question makes discovery more relevant.
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Define the GTM data contract
roadmap.body: Work with Operations and Revenue Operations on buyer roles, account identity and required fields.

roadmap.title: Build observable enrichment
roadmap.body: Add source provenance, conflict review and an owned handoff. Instrument failure and replay behavior.

roadmap.title: Improve the research sales motion
roadmap.body: Compare buyer segments and experiments using agreed qualification and cohort definitions.
roadmap.measure: Qualified pipeline and trustworthy self-serve reporting

metricsTitle: A complete field is not always a trustworthy field.
metricsIntro: Synthetic record quality and funnel stages. Role accuracy and provenance remain separate from basic completeness.
metricsNotes: Do not combine expert participants with research buyers when calculating buyer funnel conversion.
A contact conflict should remain visible until resolved; a higher completeness score does not justify overwriting uncertainty.
These examples are hypothetical operational records, not real research intelligence or investment analysis.
aiApplication: At Qualitate, I would coordinate research-organization and contact-role evidence in a shared schema, then use approved-tool inspection to check identity and source freshness. Reviewer acceptance and rejected CRM proposals would guide the next bounded improvement.
